title: Directions in Town
description: Four short recordings about finding places: a bank, a museum, a voicemail and a guided walk.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Looking for a bank
parts.intro: You will hear Tom asking Linh the way.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Excuse me. Is there a bank near here?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Yes. Go straight on and turn left at the traffic lights.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Straight on, then left.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: That's right. The bank is on the right, between the post office and the bakery.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Is it far? I don't know this town well, and I have no map.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: No, it's only five minutes on foot. But it's closed on Sundays, and today is Sunday!

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Oh no! Is there a cash machine?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Yes, there's one outside the supermarket. It's very near, next to the bus stop. You can also ask the lady in the shop. She is always very kind.

parts.title: Part 2 · Finding the museum
parts.intro: You will hear Mai asking Mr Hung for directions.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Excuse me, how can I get to the museum?

script.speaker: Mr Hung
script.text: The museum? Take the second street on the right, and walk past the park.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: The second street on the right?

script.speaker: Mr Hung
script.text: Sorry, the third street. The second one is a small road.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: OK, the third street.

script.speaker: Mr Hung
script.text: Then cross the bridge. The museum is opposite the church.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Should I take a bus?

script.speaker: Mr Hung
script.text: No, it's about ten minutes on foot. It's a nice walk.

parts.title: Part 3 · Directions to a house
parts.intro: You will hear a message from Hoa to her friend Minh.

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: Hi, Minh. It's Hoa. Here are the directions to my house for the party.

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: Get off the bus at the library. Then walk down Rose Street until you see a big yellow shop.

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: Turn right at the shop. My house is the last one on the left, next to a green gate.

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: Don't go to the old school. Lots of people go there by mistake.

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: If you get lost, call me. Don't take a taxi, it's too expensive. See you!

parts.title: Part 4 · A guided walk
parts.intro: You will hear a tour guide, Peter, talking to a group.

script.speaker: Peter
script.text: Good morning, everyone. I'm Peter, your guide, and today we're going to walk around the old town.

script.speaker: Peter
script.text: We start here at the train station. First, we walk along the river to the old market. It opens at eight o'clock.

script.speaker: Peter
script.text: Then we go up the hill to the castle. It's a long walk, but the view is fantastic.

script.speaker: Peter
script.text: At twelve o'clock we have lunch in a small café behind the castle.

script.speaker: Peter
script.text: After lunch, we take a boat back to the station. The boat trip is only fifteen minutes.
